comment: The vectors pinning the MCP wire CYFR's server and its CLI speak: Prima's codec (Prima.MCP.Protocol, Prima.MCP.Message) is the definition, and the CLI's client (apps/codex/internal/mcp) is held to it. Every request declares `protocol_version` in its params._meta under the `meta` keys, there being no handshake, and a server answers `supported`; the keys CYFR adds (progressToken, cyfr/confirmationId) are cyfr's own and pinned in cyfr's tests. A request mirrors its method into the Mcp-Method header and its named subject into Mcp-Name: `named_subject` cases are a request in and the headers it carries out, Mcp-Name absent (null) for a method that names no subject and present, encoded, for one that names an empty one. A header value travels as itself when it is non-empty visible ASCII with no surrounding whitespace that does not start with the sentinel, and otherwise as =?base64?<standard base64 with padding>?=: `header_values` cases are a value and its header, which decodes back to the value, and `header_refused` are headers whose sentinel does not decode. `error_codes` are the JSON-RPC codes by name, the specification's and CYFR's; a code name no table knows answers `fallback_code`. `consent_tags` name the consent signals, each answered with its CYFR code, and a `consent_errors` case is a signal (`tag`, `payload`) and the whole JSON-RPC error `response` it is answered as: its message the signal's sentence and its data {"tag", "payload"}. confirmation_required's error is tests/fixtures/confirmation.json's `signal.mcp`, defined there alone. A client reads the tag from data, and from the code when a proxy stripped data (`data_stripped`). Each side plays the directions it implements: Prima's test (apps/prima/test/prima/mcp/wire_vectors_test.exs) encodes and decodes header values, derives the routing headers, answers every code and produces and decodes every consent error; the CLI's test (apps/codex/internal/mcp/wire_vectors_test.go) declares the version and keys, encodes header values, derives the routing headers and reads every consent error and the auth code.

header_values.why: a URI with a space travels as itself: a space is visible ASCII inside the value
a value that itself starts with the sentinel

named_subject.why: a tool name outside ASCII travels in the sentinel
a tools/call whose name is not a string names no subject
a resources/read with no URI names no subject
an empty tool name is a subject still, sent encoded, since a server refuses a tools/call without Mcp-Name
prompts/get names no subject: the server implements no prompts

consent_errors.why: setup_required naming the node and its need

error.message: Setup required: catalyst:local.claude:1.4.0 needs a vault entry for "api_key" — grant it a profile first
Consent required: egress to api.example.com was added
Consent conflict: the consent changed while deciding — re-run the grant
Approved — re-run the command to continue (the in-flight run was stopped)

consent_errors.why: a consent error whose data a proxy stripped: the code names the tag

error.message: Consent required: permissions changed since they were approved — review and re-grant
